chat.searchModels: Search and download models on Hugging Face
chat.noMatchingChats: No conversations with this search term yet.
chat.intro: Describe what you want to build and the assistant models it for you: cubes, furniture, houses, animals – with colours and textures.
chat.local: Runs completely locally with Ollama, LM Studio, LiteLLM or another OpenAI-compatible server on your computer.
chat.meshHint: LLaMA-Mesh creates single objects as a mesh. For whole scenes with materials a code model like Qwen2.5-Coder works better.
chat.autoFix: ↻ Error reported back – the assistant is fixing it …
chat.placeholderMesh: A single object, preferably in English, e.g. “a wooden chair” (Enter = send)
chat.placeholder: e.g. “Create a spider with red eyes” (Enter = send)
chat.fastTitle: Short system prompt, small context, short answers – much faster on computers without a graphics card, but simpler objects
chat.changeTitle: On: the message changes what was built last (it is replaced, one undo step). Off: it builds something new next to it.
chat.visionHint: The model has to understand pictures (e.g. gemma3, qwen2.5vl, llava).
chat.attachPicture: Attach a picture (or paste / drop one)
chat.pictureFailed: The picture could not be read.

ollama.name: Ollama (local, free)
ollama.blurb: Runs completely on your computer, without an account and at no cost. Ideal for trying things out.
ollama.setup1: Install and start Ollama from ollama.com.
ollama.setup3: Pick a model in the next step – missing models can be installed right there.

lmstudio.name: LM Studio (local)
lmstudio.blurb: Local models with a graphical interface.
lmstudio.setup1: Install LM Studio and download a model.
lmstudio.setup2: Start the local server in the “Developer” tab (enable CORS).

litellm.blurb: A proxy in front of many providers (OpenAI, Azure, Bedrock, Gemini …) with one address.
litellm.setup1: Start the LiteLLM proxy, e.g.: litellm --model ollama/qwen2.5-coder
litellm.setup2: Enter the address and, if needed, the master key.

custom.name: Own server (OpenAI-compatible)
custom.blurb: Any service with an OpenAI-compatible interface (vLLM, llama.cpp, Jan, …).

errors.notFound: Model not found. Install it with Ollama: ollama pull <model>
errors.unreachable: Server not reachable. Is it running? For local servers you may need to allow CORS (Ollama: OLLAMA_ORIGINS="*").
errors.noMeshModel: LLaMA-Mesh is not installed. Please install it in the setup wizard.
errors.truncated: The answer was cut off – the model hit its token limit. Try again without fast mode or with a shorter request.

presets.llamaMesh: Made for 3D: creates triangle meshes directly from text (NVIDIA, Llama 3.1 license). Good for single objects.
presets.qwen3b: The fastest – answers within seconds even without a graphics card. Simpler objects, switches fast mode on.
presets.qwen7b: Writes modelling code – whole scenes with materials and textures. The best all-rounder for normal computers.
presets.qwen14b: More accurate than 7B, needs more memory.
presets.qwen3: Newer all-round model with good planning.

pull.buffered: No progress from Ollama – a virus scanner or web filter (e.g. Sophos) is probably holding the response back. The download keeps running in the background; progress only shows up at the end.

agent.noMesh: The model returned no mesh. Tip: a short English description of a single object, e.g. “a wooden chair”.

search.title: Search models
search.subtitle: Hugging Face · GGUF only (runs locally with Ollama)
search.placeholder: e.g. qwen coder, llama mesh, phi, gemma …
search.smallTitle: Hides models with more than 4 billion parameters – they answer slowly without a graphics card. Mixture-of-experts models (…-A3B) count with their active parameters.
search.ollamaOnly: Downloading only works with Ollama as the provider – but you can search and look at the models.
search.onlyBigger: No GGUF models found – only bigger ones. Untick “small only”.
search.nothing: No GGUF models found. Try a shorter search term.
search.gatedTitle: The provider requires signing in to Hugging Face
search.onlySplit: No single GGUF files found – only split files, which Ollama cannot load directly.
search.quantHint: Smaller variants are faster but less accurate.
search.needsLogin: Only with a Hugging Face sign-in
search.privacy: Only the search goes to the internet. Downloaded models run completely on your computer.
search.offline: No internet connection – the search needs the internet.
search.ggufInfo: GGUF is a file format for compressed language models. Ollama runs it directly on your computer – the same model comes in several “quants” (Q4_K_M, Q8_0 …): smaller = faster and less RAM, larger = more accurate.
search.moeTitle: Mixture of experts: big model, but only {active} billion parameters work per token – fast for its size, still needs the full file size in RAM
search.notChatTitle: This is no language model (e.g. image → 3D like TRELLIS or Hunyuan3D). It is published as GGUF, but Ollama cannot run it and it cannot write modelling code.
search.officialTitle: Published by the maker of the model itself – official sources are listed first

wizard.title: Set up the AI assistant
wizard.providerIntro: Which local AI server runs on your computer? Everything stays on your device – nothing goes to the internet. Ollama is the easiest.
wizard.keyHint: Only needed if your server requires a key (e.g. LiteLLM with a master key).
wizard.connected: Connected – {count} model found | Connected – {count} models found
wizard.modelIntro: Pick a free model. LLaMA-Mesh is trained especially for 3D and creates meshes directly; Qwen models write modelling code and can build whole scenes with materials and textures.
wizard.installHint: Installing downloads the model once via Ollama (several GB). After that everything runs offline on your computer.
wizard.autoRun: Run generated code automatically (each answer is one undo step)
wizard.tryHint: Try e.g.: “Create a cube with 2 m edges made of wood” or “Build a spider”.
wizard.quantTitle: Quantization: smaller = faster and less RAM, larger = more accurate. Q4_K_M (★) is usually the best trade-off, ✓ = installed.

plugin.name: AI assistant
plugin.description: Describe what you want and a local AI (Ollama, LM Studio …) builds it as a script or a mesh. With setup wizard, model search and history.
